```{r, Reading data}

summary(investments_VC)
```

```{r, Exploration}
table(investments_VC$status)

table(investments_VC$funding_rounds)
```

```{r, data preparation}
sort(table(investments_VC$country_code), decreasing = TRUE)


```

```{r,}
df_rounds <- as.data.frame(table(investments_VC$funding_rounds))

library(plotly)
plot_ly(
  data = df_rounds, 
  x = ~Var1, 
  y = ~Freq, 
  type = 'bar',
  marker = list(color = 'rgba(100, 150, 250, 0.7)')
) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Distribution of Funding Rounds",
    xaxis = list(title = "Number of Rounds"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Count of Companies")
  )
```
